stories.title: Iran-backed militias confirmed behind Saudi pipeline attack; Trump in Ireland points to Tehran
stories.summary: An attack on Saudi Arabia's key East-West oil pipeline was confirmed to have been carried out from Iraqi territory by Iran-linked militias, and President Trump, visiting Ireland, said Iran was 'probably' responsible as Baghdad takes countermeasures. The Gulf standoff continues to rattle oil markets with the Strait of Hormuz at the center.

stories.title: Obama voices caution on AI, urges Democrats to tackle it
stories.summary: Barack Obama warned that artificial intelligence could be 'dangerous' if not properly managed and urged Democrats to make it a policy priority, according to the New York Times. The remarks add to a weekend of prominent voices calling for more measured AI development.

stories.title: China's data regulator plans standards push for embodied AI
stories.summary: China's data regulator said it will develop standards for embodied (physical-world) AI and guide local authorities as demand for large multimodal training datasets grows. The plan points to an effort to accelerate robot-AI deployment rather than slow it.

stories.title: Browns open season at Jacksonville today: how to watch, odds, kickoff
stories.summary: Cleveland faces Jacksonville in its 2026 season opener Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS, with the Browns 8.5-point underdogs (Jaguars -8.5). Rookie Austin Barber is set to start at right guard in his hometown after Teven Jenkins was ruled out.

stories.title: No. 1 Ohio State stunned 24-23 as Texas erases 20-point deficit
stories.summary: Arch Manning led three fourth-quarter touchdown drives as No. 4 Texas rallied from 20 down to stun top-ranked Ohio State 24-23 in Austin. The Buckeyes dominated the first half and led 23-3 after three quarters before the Longhorns' furious comeback.

stories.title: How Texas, Arch Manning stunned Ohio State after rallying from 20 down
stories.summary: A detailed breakdown of the Longhorns' fourth-quarter turnaround that handed the Buckeyes a 24-23 loss, capped by three Manning touchdown drives. The win snaps OSU's win streak versus Texas and reshapes the early College Football Playoff picture.

stories.title: Spanish GP race day: new Madring circuit in Madrid hosts its first grand prix
stories.summary: Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix takes place Sunday at 2 p.m. UK time at the new Madring circuit near Madrid. Race-day guide covers start times, how to watch and a hot forecast that could make tyre degradation a factor.
